will replace the existing buyback plan, which was originally set to expire at the end of 2026. Under this plan, the company has repurchased 1.6M shares for about $21M through Sept. 10, 2026.
The company plans to fund the new buybacks with available cash and cash equivalents, with repurchases depending on market conditions, share price, and share availability.
The program will remain in effect until Dec. 31, 2027, or until the company repurchases $30M of shares, whichever comes first.
However, the company is not required to repurchase any specific number of shares, and its board can modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time.
